8    pub(super) fn push_attack_damage_modifier(
9        ctx: &mut AttackContext,
10        kind: DamageModifierKind,
11        source_id: u32,
12    ) {
13        let insertion = ctx.next_modifier_id;
14        ctx.next_modifier_id = ctx.next_modifier_id.wrapping_add(1);
15        let priority = match kind {
16            DamageModifierKind::CancelNext => 0,
17            DamageModifierKind::SetCancelable { .. } => 1,
18            DamageModifierKind::SetAmount { .. } => 2,
19            DamageModifierKind::AddAmount { .. } => 3,
20        };
21        let remaining = match kind {
22            DamageModifierKind::AddAmount { delta } if delta < 0 => -delta,
23            _ => 0,
24        };
25        ctx.damage_modifiers.push(DamageModifier {
26            kind,
27            priority,
28            insertion,
29            source_id,
30            remaining,
31            used: false,
32        });
33    }
34
35    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
36    pub(super) fn add_modifier_instance(
37        &mut self,
38        source: CardId,
39        source_slot: Option<u8>,
40        target_player: u8,
41        target_slot: u8,
42        kind: ModifierKind,
43        magnitude: i32,
44        duration: ModifierDuration,
45        layer: ModifierLayer,
46    ) -> Option<u32> {
47        let p = target_player as usize;
48        let s = target_slot as usize;
49        if s >= self.state.players[p].stage.len() {
50            return None;
51        }
52        let target_card = self.state.players[p].stage[s].card?.id;
53        let id = self.state.next_modifier_id;
54        self.state.next_modifier_id = self.state.next_modifier_id.wrapping_add(1);
55        self.state.modifiers.push(crate::state::ModifierInstance {
56            id,
57            source,
58            source_slot,
59            target_player,
60            target_slot,
61            target_card,
62            kind,
63            magnitude,
64            duration,
65            layer,
66            insertion: id,
67        });
68        if kind == ModifierKind::Power {
69            self.mark_slot_power_dirty(target_player, target_slot);
70        }
71        self.log_event(Event::ModifierAdded {
72            id,
73            source,
74            target_player,
75            target_slot,
76            target_card,
77            kind,
78            magnitude,
79            duration,
80        });
81        Some(id)
82    }

84    pub(super) fn remove_modifiers_for_slot(&mut self, player: u8, slot: u8) {
85        let p = player;
86        let s = slot;
87        let mut removed: Vec<u32> = Vec::new();
88        self.state.modifiers.retain(|m| {
89            if m.target_player != p || m.target_slot != s {
90                return true;
91            }
92            removed.push(m.id);
93            false
94        });
95        if !removed.is_empty() {
96            self.mark_slot_power_dirty(player, slot);
97        }
98        for id in removed {
99            self.log_event(Event::ModifierRemoved {
100                id,
101                reason: ModifierRemoveReason::TargetLeftStage,
102            });
103        }
104    }

106    pub(super) fn resolve_on_play_abilities(
107        &mut self,
108        player: u8,
109        source_id: CardId,
110        source_ref: Option<TargetRef>,
111    ) {
112        let db = self.db.clone();
113        let specs = db.iter_card_abilities_in_canonical_order(source_id);
114        for (ability_index, spec) in specs.iter().enumerate() {
115            if spec.kind != AbilityKind::Auto {
116                continue;
117            }
118            if spec.timing() == Some(crate::db::AbilityTiming::OnPlay) {
119                let effects = db.compiled_effects_for_ability(source_id, ability_index);
120                for effect in effects {
121                    self.enqueue_effect_spec_with_source(
122                        player,
123                        source_id,
124                        effect.clone(),
125                        source_ref,
126                    );
127                }
128            }
129        }
130    }

132    pub(super) fn apply_continuous_modifiers_for_slot(
133        &mut self,
134        player: u8,
135        slot: u8,
136        card_id: CardId,
137    ) {
138        let _ = (player, slot, card_id);
139        self.mark_continuous_modifiers_dirty();
140    }

142    pub(super) fn refresh_continuous_modifiers_if_needed(&mut self) {
143        if !self.continuous_modifiers_dirty {
144            return;
145        }
146        self.continuous_modifiers_dirty = false;
147        self.recompute_continuous_modifiers();
148    }
149
150    fn continuous_modifier_key(modifier: &ModifierInstance) -> (u32, u8, u8, u32, u8, i32, u8, u8) {
151        let kind = match modifier.kind {
152            ModifierKind::Power => 0,
153            ModifierKind::AttackCost => 1,
154            ModifierKind::CannotAttack => 2,
155        };
156        let duration = match modifier.duration {
157            ModifierDuration::UntilEndOfTurn => 0,
158            ModifierDuration::WhileOnStage => 1,
159        };
160        let source_slot = modifier.source_slot.unwrap_or(u8::MAX);
161        (
162            modifier.source,
163            source_slot,
164            modifier.target_player,
165            modifier.target_card,
166            modifier.target_slot,
167            modifier.magnitude,
168            kind,
169            duration,
170        )
171    }
172
173    fn recompute_continuous_modifiers(&mut self) {
174        let mut existing_continuous: Vec<ModifierInstance> = Vec::new();
175        let mut non_continuous: Vec<ModifierInstance> = Vec::new();
176        for modifier in self.state.modifiers.drain(..) {
177            if modifier.layer == ModifierLayer::Continuous {
178                existing_continuous.push(modifier);
179            } else {
180                non_continuous.push(modifier);
181            }
182        }
183
184        let mut next_id = self.state.next_modifier_id;
185        let mut new_continuous: Vec<ModifierInstance> = Vec::new();
186        if self.curriculum.enable_continuous_modifiers {
187            for player in 0..2u8 {
188                let max_slot = if self.curriculum.reduced_stage_mode {
189                    1
190                } else {
191                    crate::encode::MAX_STAGE
192                };
193                for slot in 0..max_slot {
194                    let slot_state = &self.state.players[player as usize].stage[slot];
195                    let Some(card_inst) = slot_state.card else {
196                        continue;
197                    };
198                    let card_id = card_inst.id;
199                    let specs = self.db.iter_card_abilities_in_canonical_order(card_id);
200                    for (ability_index, spec) in specs.iter().enumerate() {
201                        if spec.kind != AbilityKind::Continuous {
202                            continue;
203                        }
204                        let effects = self.db.compiled_effects_for_ability(card_id, ability_index);
205                        for effect in effects {
206                            if let EffectKind::AddModifier {
207                                kind,
208                                magnitude,
209                                duration,
210                            } = effect.kind
211                            {
212                                let Some(target_spec) = effect.target.as_ref() else {
213                                    continue;
214                                };
215                                self.scratch.targets.clear();
216                                Self::enumerate_target_candidates_into(
217                                    &self.state,
218                                    &self.db,
219                                    &self.curriculum,
220                                    player,
221                                    target_spec,
222                                    &[],
223                                    &mut self.scratch.targets,
224                                );
225                                let limit = if target_spec.count == 0 {
226                                    self.scratch.targets.len()
227                                } else {
228                                    target_spec.count as usize
229                                };
230                                for target in self.scratch.targets.iter().take(limit) {
231                                    new_continuous.push(ModifierInstance {
232                                        id: 0,
233                                        source: card_id,
234                                        source_slot: Some(slot as u8),
235                                        target_player: target.player,
236                                        target_slot: target.index,
237                                        target_card: target.card_id,
238                                        kind,
239                                        magnitude,
240                                        duration,
241                                        layer: ModifierLayer::Continuous,
242                                        insertion: 0,
243                                    });
244                                }
245                            }
246                        }
247                    }
248                }
249            }
250        }
251
252        existing_continuous.sort_by_key(Self::continuous_modifier_key);
253        new_continuous.sort_by_key(Self::continuous_modifier_key);
254
255        let mut changed = false;
256        let mut used_existing = vec![false; existing_continuous.len()];
257        let mut final_continuous: Vec<ModifierInstance> = Vec::with_capacity(new_continuous.len());
258        let mut existing_idx = 0usize;
259        for mut modifier in new_continuous {
260            let key = Self::continuous_modifier_key(&modifier);
261            while existing_idx < existing_continuous.len()
262                && Self::continuous_modifier_key(&existing_continuous[existing_idx]) < key
263            {
264                existing_idx += 1;
265            }
266            if existing_idx < existing_continuous.len()
267                && Self::continuous_modifier_key(&existing_continuous[existing_idx]) == key
268                && !used_existing[existing_idx]
269            {
270                let existing = &existing_continuous[existing_idx];
271                modifier.id = existing.id;
272                modifier.insertion = existing.insertion;
273                used_existing[existing_idx] = true;
274                existing_idx += 1;
275            } else {
276                modifier.id = next_id;
277                modifier.insertion = next_id;
278                next_id = next_id.wrapping_add(1);
279                changed = true;
280                self.log_event(Event::ModifierAdded {
281                    id: modifier.id,
282                    source: modifier.source,
283                    target_player: modifier.target_player,
284                    target_slot: modifier.target_slot,
285                    target_card: modifier.target_card,
286                    kind: modifier.kind,
287                    magnitude: modifier.magnitude,
288                    duration: modifier.duration,
289                });
290            }
291            final_continuous.push(modifier);
292        }
293
294        for (idx, modifier) in existing_continuous.iter().enumerate() {
295            if used_existing.get(idx).copied().unwrap_or(false) {
296                continue;
297            }
298            changed = true;
299            self.log_event(Event::ModifierRemoved {
300                id: modifier.id,
301                reason: ModifierRemoveReason::ContinuousRefresh,
302            });
303        }
304
305        if next_id != self.state.next_modifier_id {
306            self.state.next_modifier_id = next_id;
307        }
308        self.state.modifiers = non_continuous;
309        self.state.modifiers.extend(final_continuous);
310        if changed {
311            self.mark_all_slot_power_dirty();
312            self.state.turn.derived_attack = None;
313        }
314    }
